admission.scope: local cooperative admission; no exclusive CPU claim

limitations: Same candidate executable with cache toggled; no old-versus-new executable claim.
Historical fixtures and replay inputs are outcome selected, not independent scientific trials.
One timing per configuration on a cooperatively admitted host; no confidence interval or established speedup.
Supervised elapsed times and sampled process-tree RSS are reported separately from controller overhead and nested stage timing.
Interpolation wall time is within observation-design wall time, within row-build wall time. Child CPU is a different measurement; do not add these quantities.
Final linearization and parent nuisance solves/recovery/update lack sidecar timing; absent measurements remain unknown.
All twelve nuisance profiles converged strictly. No floor-limited pass is used here; such progress cannot authorize covariance.
These tests do not repeat the complete propagation/objective validation suite or establish full orbit fit/covariance acceptance.
Frozen v4 campaign continues with its original executable and attempts; this candidate does not replace its results.
